children: Wells Fargo says its consumer and business customers are doing well, even with economic uncertainty looming and mixed consumer sentiment. "Consumers are spending more, loan delinquencies are low, and deposit and investment balances have grown," CEO Charlie Scharf says in a statement alongside the company's 3Q results. Businesses, meanwhile, continue to have strong balance sheets and losses remain low, he says. "While higher interest rates, higher oil prices and persistent inflation create risks to the economy, strong positive forces such as the investment in AI infrastructure, high employment levels and consistent wage growth continue to outweigh the risks." (kelly.cloonan@wsj.com)
